label: preparing
what: Preparing a bread-supplied evening gathering in the great hall at day 1, 18:00, organized by the innkeeper, builder and freight as a hospitality committee. The occasion and full purpose have not been disclosed to me. Baker and neighbour knowingly helped with bread or supplies; secretary knowingly assists scheduling and escorting me at precisely eighteen, but there is no evidence that these helpers know any concealed purpose. A surprise celebration is possible but not established; bridge or port changes are only unconfirmed rumours.
